slots.name: net territorial gains
slots.sentence: The ISW has estimated Russia’s net gains this year at 148sq km (57sq miles), nowhere near the 5,300sq km that Russia claims.

slots.name: September territorial gains
slots.sentence: Moscow captured about 361 sq km in September, according to the military analyst Konrad Muzyka

slots.name: territorial loss
slots.sentence: Russian forces lost control over almost 300 square kilometers (116 square miles) of Ukraine between March and September, the Washington-based think tank said in a report late Thursday.

events.label: Ukraine counteroffensive territorial gains in September 2026

slots.name: Vivaldi territorial gains
slots.sentence: Ukraine, meanwhile, has clawed back about 126 sq km in a series of counteroffensives in the east, being conducted under the codename Vivaldi.

slots.name: territory occupied by Russia
slots.sentence: Russian forces have occupied roughly 990 square kilometers (about 380 square miles) of Ukrainian territory since the beginning of 2026, while Ukrainian forces have retaken about 820 square kilometers (316 square miles), according to figures cited by Zelenskyy, who added that Kyiv aims to bring those figures closer to parity by year’s end.
